U00X: You are Merciful, the Destroyer of all pain. Please give me Your Ear and listen to my prayer.
You are Merciful and the Destroyer of the calamities. Give ear and hear a supplication of mine.
7UEH: Please unite me with the True Guru, my breath of life; through Him, O my Lord and Master, You are known. ||1||
Unite me with the True Guru, my very Life, Through whom you are known, O Lord God.
M0NW: O Lord, I acknowledge the True Guru as the Supreme Lord God.
O Pervading God, I acknowledge the True Guru as the Exalted Lord Himself.
A1T7: I am foolish and ignorant, and my intellect is impure. Through the Teachings of the Guru, the True Guru, O Lord, I come to know You. ||1||Pause||
I am silly, stupid and of impure understanding. By means of Gurbani of the great True Guru I have known You, O God. Pause.
XAD2: All the pleasures and enjoyments which I have seen - I have found them all to be bland and insipid.
As many pleasures, and other relishes which I have seen, all of them, without exception, I have found thoroughly insipid.

3Z52: I have tasted the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, by meeting the True Guru. It is sweet, like the juice of the sugarcane. ||2||
By meeting the Satguru, I have tasted the immortalising Nectar of God's Name, which is sweet like the juice of sugarcane.
JT51: Those who have not met the Guru, the True Guru, are foolish and insane - they are faithless cynics.
Who have not met the great True Guru, they are the foolish, and insane mammon-worshippers.
ECH2: Those who were pre-ordained to have no good karma at all - gazing into the lamp of emotional attachment, they are burnt, like moths in a flame. ||3||
They are pre-ordained to be bereft of Good deeds. By beholding the lamp of worldly love, they are burnt like a moth.
Y1W8: Those whom You, in Your Mercy, have met, Lord, are committed to Your Service.
they, whom You, O Lord Master, mercifully unitest with the Guru, apply themselves to Your service.
6XN2: Servant Nanak chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. He is famous, and through the Guru's Teachings, He merges in the Name. ||4||4||18||56||
Servant Nanak is renowned by repeating the Name of Lord god and by the Guru's instruction his soul is absorbed in the Name.
SHMN: O my mind, God is always with you; He is your Lord and Master. Tell me, where could you run to get away from the Lord?
My soul, that Lord God is ever with you. Tell me where can you run away from God?
0SPA: The True Lord God Himself grants forgiveness; we are emancipated only when the Lord Himself emancipates us. ||1||
The True Lord God Himself grants pardon. If God Himself delivers the man, he stands delivered,
E664: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har - chant it in your mind.
O my soul, heartily repeat and remember the Lord God's Name.
99F4: Quickly now, run to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, O my mind; following the Guru, the True Guru, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||
Run and take to the sanctuary of the True Guru, O My mind. You shall be saved by following the great Satguru. Pause.
FNX9: O my mind, serve God, the Giver of all peace; serving Him, you shall come to dwell in your own home deep within.
My soul, serve that Lord, the Giver of all the comforts, by performing whose service you shall abide in your own home.
3HA9: As Gurmukh, go and enter your own home; anoint yourself with the sandalwood oil of the Lord's Praises. ||2||
Through the Guru, go and attain to your home, and rub and apply the sandal of God's praises to yourself.
DYM3: O my mind, the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, are exalted and sublime. Earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and let your mind be happy.
O my soul, God's, God's, God's God's only God's praises are sublime. Earn the profit of singing God's praises and be happy in your mind
2UZ5: If the Lord, Har, Har, in His Mercy, bestows it, then we partake of the ambrosial essence of the Lord's Name. ||3||
If the Lord God Himself mercifully grants, then alone man partakes of the immortalising God's elixir.
48RM: O my mind, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and attached to duality, those faithless cynics are strangled by the Messenger of Death.
O my soul, who are without God's Name, and are attached with another, those materialistic persons, are strangulated by death's myrmidon.
YUSV: Such faithless cynics, who have forgotten the Naam, are thieves. O my mind, do not even go near them. ||4||
Such materialists, who have forgotten the Lord's Name, are thieves. My soul draw not near them.
PF9D: O my mind, serve the Unknowable and Immaculate Lord, the Man-lion; serving Him, your account will be cleared.
My soul, serve the incomprehensible and immaculate Man-lion by serving whom the account is discharged.
WT0Z: The Lord God has made servant Nanak perfect; he is not diminished by even the tiniest particle. ||5||5||19||57||
The Lord God has made slave Nanak perfect, and his weight is not, few, short even by a fraction of a particle.
UA5K: My breath of life is in Your Power, God; my soul and body are totally Yours.
My very life is in Your power, O Lord. My soul and body are all Yours.
0PAJ: Be merciful to me, and show me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. There is such a great longing within my mind and body! ||1||
Show mercy, and cause me to see Yours sight, O God within my soul and body, is the great yearning.
5GBF: O my Lord, there is such a great longing within my mind and body to meet the Lord.
My Master, within my mind and body is the desire to meet God.
Q2WK: When the Guru, the Merciful Guru, showed just a little mercy to me, my Lord God came and met me. ||1||Pause||
When the great and merciful Guru, showed even an iota of compassion, My Lord God came and met me. Pause.
7D04: Whatever is in my conscious mind, O Lord and Master - that condition of mine is known only to You, Lord.
Whatever is in my mind and heart, O Lord God that condition of mind You Knowest.
1SAY: Night and day, I chant Your Name, and I find peace. I live by placing my hopes in You, Lord. ||2||
Night and day I repeat Your Name and obtain peace. I ever, live in Yours expectation, O God.
YUVD: The Guru, the True Guru, the Giver, has shown me the Way; my Lord God came and met me.
The great beneficent True Guru showed me the way, and my Lord God came and revealed Himself to me.
30L2: Night and day, I am filled with bliss; by great good fortune, all of the hopes of His humble servant have been fulfilled. ||3||
Night and day celestial bliss rains. I have become very fortunate and all the desires of God's slave are fulfilled.
0ZMN: O Lord of the World, Master of the Universe, everything is under Your control.
O my God, the Lord of the world and the Master of the Universe, everybody is under Yours sway.
6T6C: Servant Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, Lord; please, preserve the honor of Your humble servant. ||4||6||20||58||
Servant Nanak has entered Yours sanctuary, O God, save the honour of Yours sanctuary, O God, save the honour of Yours servant.
R2K2: This mind does not hold still, even for an instant. Distracted by all sorts of distractions, it wanders around aimlessly in the ten directions.
This mind of many whims rests not for a moment. It wanders about aimlessly in all the ten directions.
